class.name: StreamReadinessGate
class.brief_description: Readiness gate that reveals a streamed cell only once data, GPU, physics and navmesh stages are all done.
class.description: Stages are reported with [method mark] or discovered by polling per-stage probe callables in [method update]. GPU upload and physics need data; navmesh needs physics. An early mark of a later stage is remembered but does not count until its prerequisites are met. Stages that wait too long are reported once as stuck. Navmesh bakes can be queued with [method warmup_navmesh] and are run under a budget by [method process_warmup].

method.name: get_warmup_failed
method.description: Returns the cells whose navmesh warmup was given up.

method.name: get_stuck_log
method.description: Returns all stuck reports so far ([code]cell[/code], [code]stage[/code], [code]stage_name[/code], [code]waited[/code]).

method.name: set_probe
method.description: Sets a probe [code]func(cell: Vector2i) -> bool[/code] polled in [method update] until it returns [code]true[/code].

method.name: set_auto_warmup
method.description: Enables automatic navmesh warmup: as soon as a cell's physics become ready, [param bake] ([code]func(cell) -> bool[/code]) is queued.

method.name: begin
method.description: Starts tracking [param cell] at time [param now].

method.name: release
method.description: Stops tracking [param cell] and drops its queued warmups.

method.name: is_tracked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param cell] is tracked.

method.name: mark
method.description: Marks [param stage] done for [param cell]. [param now] [code]< 0[/code] keeps the last known time.

method.name: ready_mask
method.description: Returns the bit mask of stages that count as done (prerequisites applied).

method.name: is_stage_ready
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param stage] counts as done for [param cell].

method.name: is_revealable
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when every stage is done.

method.name: is_revealed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once [method update] has reported the cell as revealable.

method.name: waiting_stage
method.description: Returns the first stage the cell is waiting on, or [code]0[/code] when complete.

method.name: update
method.description: Polls probes, tracks timeouts and returns the cells that just became revealable (once each).

method.name: warmup_navmesh
method.description: Queues a navmesh bake [code]func(cell) -> bool[/code] for [param cell]; it runs from [method process_warmup] once the cell's physics are ready.

method.name: pending_warmups
method.description: Returns the number of queued navmesh bakes.

method.name: process_warmup
method.description: Runs up to [param max_count] queued bakes, stopping early after [param max_usec] microseconds when positive. Cells whose physics are not ready are skipped without consuming budget. Returns the number of bakes run.

method.name: probe_rids_valid
method.description: Ready-made GPU probe: [code]true[/code] when the array is non-empty and every [RID] is valid.

method.name: probe_body_shapes
method.description: Ready-made physics probe: the body exists and owns at least [param min_shapes] shapes.

method.name: probe_nav_region
method.description: Ready-made navmesh probe: the region exists and its navigation iteration was published.

members.member: Seconds a stage may wait before it is reported as stuck.
Per-stage timeout overrides keyed by [enum Stage] value.
Navmesh bake attempts before a cell's warmup is given up.
Optional callback [code]func(report: Dictionary)[/code] invoked when a stage becomes stuck.
Optional callback [code]func(cell: Vector2i)[/code] invoked when a cell becomes revealable.
